description: VeriPIE helps users compare business options, analyze selected CSV or text data, and inspect decision reports. ChatGPT reasons using the VeriPIE skill and submits a structured draft. The MCP server stores selected evidence, executes bounded CSV and mathematical calculations, checks framework requirements and renders original HTML, text or JSON reports. The server makes no model-provider calls. Reports remain provisional and explicitly state that independent AI or human review was not performed. Calculations do not establish source truth, guarantee outcomes or authorize business actions.

defaultPrompt: Compare these options against my goals, budget, and constraints. Recommend an option and explain the trade-offs.
Analyze these CSV files, flag data problems, and show which findings matter for my decision.
Create a decision report showing the supporting evidence, checked calculations, and assumptions that still need verification.
